# MiaoYan (妙言)

> A lightweight, local-first Markdown note-taking app for Mac, iPhone and iPad, built natively with Swift 6.

Official website: https://miaoyan.app/ (also in Simplified Chinese /zh/, Traditional Chinese /tw/, Japanese /ja/, Korean /ko/, German /de/, French /fr/ and Spanish /es/)
Source code: https://github.com/tw93/MiaoYan
App Store (Mac, iPhone and iPad in one purchase): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759252269
Author: Tw93, https://tw93.fun/

## Who it is for

MiaoYan is for people who want a focused, native writing app on Mac, iPhone and iPad that keeps ordinary Markdown files in a folder they choose. It does not collect note data. iCloud Drive, Nutstore, Dropbox, or another file-sync client can sync that folder when needed.

## Key capabilities

- Pure Markdown editing with a separate real-time preview
- Split editor and preview with 60fps bidirectional scroll sync
- Wikilinks and backlinks
- LaTeX math, plus Mermaid, PlantUML and Markmap diagrams
- Version history, auto-formatting, keyboard shortcuts, and dark mode
- Markdown presentation mode and a command-line interface
- Native Swift 6 app with no Electron runtime
- Requires macOS 12.0 or later; the iPhone and iPad apps require iOS 18.0 or iPadOS 18.0 or later

## Installation

- Free and open-source Mac app (MIT): `brew install --cask miaoyan`, or a DMG from https://github.com/tw93/MiaoYan/releases/latest
- App Store: one purchase covers the Mac, iPhone and iPad apps, with automatic updates

The Mac app's source code is open on GitHub and keeps being developed. The iPhone and iPad apps are not open source, so they ship on the App Store together with the Mac app. On every device MiaoYan opens the same notes folder, for example one in iCloud Drive.

## Comparisons

Compared with Typora, MiaoYan does not use a WYSIWYG editor. It keeps the Markdown source and preview separate for people who want direct control of the file.

Compared with Obsidian, MiaoYan has no Electron runtime and is not centered on a plugin ecosystem. It favors a smaller set of built-in writing features and local Markdown files.

## Blog

English posts are at https://miaoyan.app/blog/ and Chinese ones at https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/.

- [Choosing a Markdown editor for Mac](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-editor-for-mac/): What to check in a Mac Markdown editor: plain files, WYSIWYG or split preview, math, sync and speed, with Typora, Obsidian, VS Code and MiaoYan compared.
- [Markdown cheat sheet: CommonMark, GFM and extensions](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-cheat-sheet/): The Markdown syntax you actually use, with examples, what CommonMark and GFM each define, and what MiaoYan renders on top.
- [LaTeX math in Markdown: syntax, KaTeX and pitfalls](https://miaoyan.app/blog/latex-math-in-markdown/): Write inline and block math in Markdown, use common LaTeX constructs, avoid dollar and underscore pitfalls, and see how MiaoYan renders KaTeX.
- [Mermaid diagrams in Markdown: flowchart, sequence, Gantt](https://miaoyan.app/blog/mermaid-diagrams-in-markdown/): Draw flowcharts, sequence and Gantt diagrams with fenced Mermaid blocks, plus PlantUML and Markmap, and what MiaoYan renders offline.
- [Markdown to slides: --- separators and MiaoYan PPT mode](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-to-slides/): Turn a Markdown note into a slide deck with --- separators, configure reveal.js options, and compare Marp, reveal.js and Slidev.
- [Typora alternative for Mac: split preview with MiaoYan](https://miaoyan.app/blog/typora-alternative-mac/): Why people leave Typora, WYSIWYG versus split preview, what carries over (files, math, images) and where each app is stronger.
- [Local-first Markdown notes: keep them as plain files](https://miaoyan.app/blog/local-first-markdown-notes/): Why plain Markdown files in your own folder beat a locked-in notes app, what it costs, and how MiaoYan reads the folder you choose.
- [Sync Markdown notes across devices without a sync service](https://miaoyan.app/blog/sync-markdown-notes-across-devices/): Use iCloud Drive, Nutstore, Dropbox or git to sync a Markdown notes folder, set MiaoYan's Note Location, and avoid conflict copies.
- [Wikilinks and backlinks in Markdown notes](https://miaoyan.app/blog/wikilinks-and-backlinks/): How [[wikilinks]] differ from normal Markdown links, what MiaoYan supports, how backlinks are built, and the portability trade-offs.
- [Markdown notes from the terminal with the miao CLI](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-notes-from-terminal/): Install the miao CLI, learn open, new, search, list and cat, script them, and use them with AI coding agents and the MiaoYan skill.
- [A lighter Obsidian alternative for Mac](https://miaoyan.app/blog/obsidian-alternative-mac/): What MiaoYan has and leaves out compared with Obsidian, how to open a vault, and which syntax carries over.
- [Markdown note version history: MiaoYan, Time Machine, git](https://miaoyan.app/blog/markdown-note-version-history/): How MiaoYan saves and restores note versions, where they live, their limits, and how Time Machine and git cover what it does not.

- [Mac 上怎么选 Markdown 编辑器](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-editor-for-mac/): 从纯文件、所见即所得、公式图表、同步和性能几方面比较 Typora、Obsidian、VS Code 与妙言。
- [Markdown 语法速查与 GFM 差异](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-cheat-sheet/): 常用 Markdown 语法加示例，区分 CommonMark、GFM 与应用扩展，并说明妙言实际能渲染什么。
- [Markdown 里写 LaTeX 公式](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/latex-math-in-markdown/): 行内与块级公式的写法、常用 LaTeX 结构、美元符号和下划线的坑，以及妙言如何用 KaTeX 渲染。
- [Markdown 里画 Mermaid 图](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/mermaid-diagrams-in-markdown/): 用围栏代码块画流程图、时序图和甘特图，对比 PlantUML 与 Markmap，并说明妙言哪些图离线可用。
- [Markdown 转幻灯片：用 --- 分页](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-to-slides/): 用 --- 把笔记分成幻灯片，配置 reveal.js 选项，并比较妙言 PPT 模式与 Marp、Slidev。
- [Mac 上的 Typora 替代品](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/typora-alternative-mac/): 为什么有人离开 Typora，所见即所得与分栏预览的取舍，笔记、公式和图片能带走什么，以及两者各自强在哪里。
- [本地优先的 Markdown 笔记怎么管](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/local-first-markdown-notes/): 为什么把笔记存成自己文件夹里的纯 Markdown 文件，要付出什么，以及妙言怎么读取你选的文件夹。
- [跨设备同步 Markdown 笔记的几种做法](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/sync-markdown-notes-across-devices/): 用 iCloud 云盘、坚果云、Dropbox 或 git 同步笔记文件夹，在妙言里设置笔记位置，并避开冲突副本。
- [Markdown 笔记里的 Wikilink 与反向链接](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/wikilinks-and-backlinks/): [[wikilink]] 和普通 Markdown 链接有什么不同，妙言支持什么，反向链接怎么生成，可移植性上要付出什么。
- [在终端里使用 Markdown 笔记：miao 命令行](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-notes-from-terminal/): 安装 miao，掌握 open、new、search、list、cat，写脚本，并配合 AI 编码 Agent 和妙言 skill 使用。
- [Mac 上更轻的 Obsidian 替代品](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/obsidian-alternative-mac/): 妙言和 Obsidian 相比有什么、没有什么，怎么打开 vault，以及哪些语法能带过来。
- [Markdown 笔记的版本历史怎么用](https://miaoyan.app/zh/blog/markdown-note-version-history/): 妙言如何保存和恢复笔记版本、存在哪里、有什么限制，以及 Time Machine 和 git 怎么补上它覆盖不到的部分。
